rules.statement: A court can consider the reasonableness and legality of the basis on which a Competent Authority formed an opinion that a land is State land, when exercising its jurisdiction in terms of Article 140.
rules.supporting_quote: This Court therefore takes the view that when exercising its jurisdiction in terms of Article 140, it is entitled to consider the reasonableness and the legality of the basis on which the Competent Authority formed his opinion as required by Section 3(1) of the Act.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 3(1) of the State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act No.7 of 1979
